results.detail: verify.ps1 passed all four local test executables, including hibiki_contract_tests with the Issue 1335 job-object-failure fixtures: an injected forced-termination failure during quarantine records exactly one de-identified job_object_failure entry (non-zero captured_utc, zero exit code, non-zero module digest) and suppresses the duplicate watchdog-timeout reason for the same lifecycle event; a subsequent independent stop() records nothing further and serialized output contains no raw plugin path bytes.
handoff-check #1335 (claimed ownership, scope and Git state), docs-check (87 required paths), source-policy (734 tracked paths), and git diff --check all exited 0 in the isolated worktree.
Without an injected failure, quarantine records only the original watchdog timeout reason and no job_object_failure entry appears, confirming normal-path behavior is unchanged.

limitations: Evidence covers user-space control-plane observability of a simulated forced-termination failure via a test-only injection flag; it does not exercise a real kernel TerminateJobObject breakdown.
It does not demonstrate minidump capture, symbol resolution, production worker policy integration, WaveRT delivery, driver installation, HLK validation, or signing.
The provenance digest binds this manifest to the staged SPEC-0008, contract-test and vst-host source set; it does not independently attest that declared commands ran.
